title: Worth $200K, Still Short on Bills? Cash Flow vs Net Worth

scenes.vo: A six-figure net worth can't pay your electric bill.
Net worth is a snapshot: own minus owe. Cash flow is the movie: money in, money out.

captions.text: Net worth is a snapshot: own minus owe.

medianBalance.period: 2025 survey; median among the 98.7% of families holding transaction accounts
medianBalance.source: Federal Reserve, Changes in U.S. Family Finances from 2022 to 2025 (Survey of Consumer Finances), survey year 2025, published 2026-10-09; https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/files/scf26.pdf

latePayments.unit: % of families reporting late loan payments
latePayments.source: Federal Reserve, Changes in U.S. Family Finances from 2022 to 2025 (Survey of Consumer Finances), survey year 2025, published 2026-10-09; https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/files/scf26.pdf. medianHomeEquity.source: Federal Reserve press release, survey year 2025, published 2026-10-09; https://federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/other20261009a.htm

notes: The S4 figures are separate survey measures, not one family.
'Bank balance' simplifies 'transaction accounts' (checking, savings, money market, call accounts, prepaid debit cards).
